difficulty.rationale: Student describes direction, form, and strength from a scatterplot, using the given r and slope as support. They also identify one clearly separated outlier. Concept depth is shallow, and the distractors are straightforward (wrong direction, curved form, or no unusual points). No computation is needed, and reading load is low.
